indicator_name: Short-term economic indicator, volume index by region and activity, year-to-date
description: Индекс краткосрочного экономического индикатора по отраслям экономики регионов, нарастающим итогом
unit: % of the same period of the previous year, year-to-date
methodology: Sheet «Динамика»: a block per region, a header of «ИФО, январь-март 2021 г. к …» periods, activity rows (dictionaries/kei_activities.csv; «Связь» kept as COMMUNICATIONS, the index itself as TOTAL). From January 2021.
transformation: as published: year-to-date period in % of the same period of the previous year -- not converted to discrete periods
